chapterTitle: Chapter 29 The Organic Chemistry of Metabolic Pathways
title: Problem 29-5

pages.text: PROBLEM 29-5 Evidence for the role of acetate in fatty-acid biosynthesis comes from isotope-labeling experiments. If acetate labeled with 13C in the methyl group (13CH3CO2H) were incorporated into fatty acids, at what positions in the fatty-acid chain would you expect the 13C label to appear?
